sub_graphs.title: Prague: MODEXP Precompile Execution Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the complete execution lifecycle of the modular exponentiation precompile from input parsing through computation to output

nodes.label: MODEXP Precompile Called
nodes.description: Modular exponentiation precompile (address 0x05) invoked

nodes.label: Parse Length Fields
nodes.description: Extract base_length, exp_length, modulus_length from first 96 bytes (big-endian)

nodes.label: Lengths Parsed
nodes.description: All three length values extracted from input data

nodes.label: Extract Base Value
nodes.description: Read base_length bytes starting at offset 96

nodes.label: Extract Exponent Value
nodes.description: Read exp_length bytes starting at offset 96 + base_length

nodes.label: Extract Modulus Value
nodes.description: Read modulus_length bytes starting at offset 96 + base_length + exp_length

nodes.label: All Values Extracted
nodes.description: Base, exponent, and modulus values have been extracted from input

nodes.label: Extract Exponent Head
nodes.description: Get first 32 bytes of exponent (with leading zero padding if shorter)

nodes.label: Calculate Gas Cost
nodes.description: Invoke gas_cost(base_length, modulus_length, exp_length, exponent_head)

nodes.label: Gas Cost Calculated
nodes.description: Gas cost determined based on complexity and iterations

nodes.label: Charge Gas
nodes.description: Deduct computed gas from available gas

nodes.label: Gas Charged Successfully
nodes.description: Gas deducted, execution can proceed

nodes.label: Check for Zero Modulus
nodes.description: Determine if modulus equals zero (special case)

nodes.label: Modulus is Zero
nodes.description: Modulus equals zero, result is zero bytes

nodes.label: Modulus is Non-Zero
nodes.description: Normal modular exponentiation can proceed

nodes.label: Compute Modular Exponentiation
nodes.description: Execute pow(base, exp, modulus) using Python's built-in

nodes.label: Result Computed
nodes.description: Modular exponentiation result available

nodes.label: Pad Result to Modulus Length
nodes.description: Convert result to big-endian bytes of length modulus_length

nodes.label: Output Zero Bytes
nodes.description: Write modulus_length zero bytes for zero modulus case

nodes.label: MODEXP Complete
nodes.description: Result written to evm.output, precompile finished

sub_graphs.title: Prague: MODEXP Gas Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas calculation formula including complexity and iteration factors

nodes.label: Gas Calculation Started
nodes.description: Beginning MODEXP gas cost calculation

nodes.label: GQUADDIVISOR Constant
nodes.description: Gas divisor constant (value = 3)

nodes.label: Minimum Gas (200)
nodes.description: Floor value for MODEXP gas cost

nodes.label: Calculate Complexity
nodes.description: Compute ((max(base_length, modulus_length) + 7) // 8) ^ 2

nodes.label: Complexity Computed
nodes.description: Complexity factor in 8-byte words squared

nodes.label: Calculate Iterations
nodes.description: Compute iteration count based on exponent bit length

nodes.label: Check Exponent Length
nodes.description: Determining iteration calculation path

nodes.label: Exponent <= 32 Bytes
nodes.description: Short exponent, use exponent_head directly

nodes.label: Exponent > 32 Bytes
nodes.description: Long exponent, add extra iterations

nodes.label: Compute Bit Length
nodes.description: Determine highest set bit position in exponent_head

nodes.label: Add Extra Iterations
nodes.description: Add 8 * (exp_length - 32) to iteration count

nodes.label: Iterations Computed
nodes.description: Final iteration count determined

nodes.label: Multiply Complexity and Iterations
nodes.description: Compute complexity * iterations

nodes.label: Divide by GQUADDIVISOR
nodes.description: Divide product by 3

nodes.label: Apply Minimum Gas
nodes.description: Return max(200, calculated_cost)

nodes.label: Final Gas Cost
nodes.description: Gas cost ready for charging

ambiguities.text: The specification states 'iterations = 0' when exponent_head equals zero, but later mentions 'minimum iterations of 1'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the gas calculation enforces a minimum of 1 iteration to prevent zero-cost operations, but the actual computation uses standard modexp semantics.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly define behavior when input data is shorter than declared lengths
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume zero-padding is applied for missing bytes, consistent with EVM memory semantics.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'first 32 bytes of the exponent (with leading zero padding if it is shorter)' does not specify if this applies before or after extracting from input
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume exponent_head is constructed by taking min(32, exp_length) bytes from the exponent data, left-padded with zeros to 32 bytes.

implicit_assumptions.description: Python's built-in pow(base, exp, modulus) function correctly implements modular exponentiation with constant-time behavior
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Timing side-channel attacks could leak information about the exponent in RSA private key operations.

implicit_assumptions.description: The gas cost formula accurately reflects the computational complexity of modular exponentiation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced operations could enable denial of service attacks through computationally expensive modexp calls.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot craft inputs that cause non-terminating or excessively long computations beyond gas limits
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Specially crafted inputs could cause node slowdowns or consensus failures.

implicit_assumptions.description: The minimum gas cost of 200 is sufficient to prevent spam attacks using trivial modexp calls
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Spam attacks using cheap modexp calls could degrade network performance.
